title: plugin-auth: set-user-manager's depth cap counts only the chain above the new manager, so linking bottom-up builds a manager chain past MAX_MANAGER_CHAIN_DEPTH (each link 200)
body:
Filing gate: class (b), contract violation. Measured by the #26616 card thread during PR #26763 (contract review `6445518048` on that PR, should-fix (b)). The bug predates that PR. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017, session `session_01WGufzfhobWEgUUrjz4rrbh`). ⛔ Not a claim.

Governing text: `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-set-user-manager.ts:69-72`: "**Depth** — refused past `MAX_MANAGER_CHAIN_DEPTH`. ADR-0057 D3 requires the hierarchy rollups it feeds to be "bounded (hard cap + cache, mirroring the `org_user_ids` cap)"; an unbounded chain written here is an unbounded rollup there."

## What was measured

Read at `origin/main` `a485b5a3`:
- `walkChain` (`admin-set-user-manager.ts:329-357`) starts at the proposed manager and counts `1` (the edge being written) plus each ancestor above that manager. It never counts the subordinates already below the edited user.
- Writing `B.manager = A`, then `C.manager = B`, and so on from the top is refused at link 21.
- Writing from the bottom, `U20.manager = U21`, then `U19.manager = U20`, …, then `U1.manager = U2`, is not refused. Each write sees a short chain above the proposed manager, but each one extends a chain that already hangs below the edited user. Every link answers 200, and the finished chain is 21+ links deep.
- Reach: `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/set-user-manager` (public admin endpoint), and the demoStaff provisioning that reuses `applyUserManagerLink` (#26763).

Re-check: `grep -n "let links = 1" packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-set-user-manager.ts`. While the walk only goes upward, the hole is present.

## Wanted

Bound the whole chain the write creates: the depth above the proposed manager, plus 1, plus the longest chain of existing subordinates below the edited user. Refuse with the existing `too_deep` reason when the total passes the cap. Pin both orders (top-down and bottom-up, 21 links) and the boundary at exactly 20.

**Business reason:** the hierarchy rollups ADR-0057 D3 feeds (manager-and-subordinates scopes) promise a bounded walk. A chain past the cap is resolved only in part. A manager then silently loses sight of records owned deep in their chain, and nothing tells the admin who built it.

**Reader who acts:** `domain:server` (`plugin-auth`). No spec change.

Dedupe: open issues grepped for "set-user-manager depth cap", "manager chain depth bottom-up" and "MAX_MANAGER_CHAIN_DEPTH subordinates": none.

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
